changes: Added wrapper-root gitRoot diagnostics to lattice config doctor, added explicit confirmed lattice config repair, registered the command policy/process fact level, and extended field regression smoke coverage for resolver and review_run_start behavior.
usage: Run lattice config doctor in a wrapper metadata root to see wrapperGitRoot diagnostics. If it reports a single candidate, run lattice config repair --set-git-root=<child-repo> --confirm, then rerun story_resolve or review_run_start.
expectedOutcome: For metadataRoot outside the git repo with exactly one child git repo, users see a suggested gitRoot and explicit repair command. Before repair signed workspace resolution fails closed; after confirmed repair it resolves through configured-git-root.

outcomeDiff: No functional diff from expected. The implementation stayed explicit and host-neutral: diagnostics suggest, repair requires --set-git-root and --confirm, and resolver behavior remains fail-closed until config is written.
limitations: none - fully covered for the scoped wrapper-root gitRoot repair UX; this does not claim full Lattice convergence or unattended authority readiness.
pitfalls: The key pitfall was symlinked macOS temp roots: missing child targets must report target does not exist, so validation now checks lexical containment before existence and canonical containment only after the target exists.
